metadata.content: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Touleen faces Forty Years On at Doncaster | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Today on Sky Sports Racing: Touleen faces Forty Years On at Doncaster It's Touleen versus Forty Years On in the feature contest from Doncaster from Sunday, as the curtain comes down on Town Moor's St Leger Festival; Bath and ParisLongchamp also play host to competitive cards, live on Sky Sports Racing. Saturday 12 September 2026 23:31, UK Image: Touleen The final day of the St Leger Festival sees Touleen clash with Forty Years On. 3.05 Doncaster - Classy fillies Forty Years On and Touleen do battle The feature on the final day of the Betfred St Leger Festival sees top fillies Forty Years On and Touleen do battle in the Group 3 Japan Racing Association Sceptre Fillies' Stakes . Touleen tops the ratings for Owen Burrows and new pilot David Probert. She has shown top-class form on her day but has been beaten the last twice including in this grade. Her trainer has enlisted cheekpieces as she seeks a first stakes success, having been arguably unlucky when beaten by Precise in the Coronation Stakes earlier this term. George Scott's Forty Years On has a rapidly progressive profile having scored on her last two starts and, given the impression she made over course and distance last time, she must be feared in this hotter heat. metadata.content: Ryan Garcia finishes Conor Benn in just two rounds to defend WBC welterweight world championship in Las Vegas | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Ryan Garcia finishes Conor Benn in just two rounds to defend WBC welterweight world championship in Las Vegas Conor Benn moved back to welterweight to challenger American star Ryan Garcia for the WBC world championship at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas; Garcia overwhelmed Benn with a stunning onslaught in the second round to defend his title John Dennen Sports Journalist @johndennen Sunday 13 September 2026 10:12, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ryan Garcia retained his WBC world title after flooring Conor Benn heavily before forcing a stoppage victory in the second round. Fight footage courtesy of DAZN. Ryan Garcia hammered Conor Benn to defeat inside two rounds at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. Garcia successfully defended the WBC welterweight championship with a ruthless display of speed, power and precision, ending Benn's world title dream early in their Las Vegas showdown. Benn was stepping up to a new level in the first world title fight of his career as the UK star attempted to secure what would have been one of British boxing's biggest overseas upsets. messages.text: Furious Arteta rages over 'unacceptable' Sunderland penalty call

metadata.summary: A furious Mikel Arteta described Sunderland's penalty in Arsenal's 2-0 win at the Stadium of Light as "unacceptable".
metadata.content: Mikel Arteta rages at Sunderland penalty decision after Arsenal win at Stadium of Light: 'This cannot happen' | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Mikel Arteta rages at Sunderland penalty decision after Arsenal win at Stadium of Light: 'This cannot happen' Mikel Arteta was left furious by the award of Sunderland's penalty during Arsenal's 2-0 win at the Stadium of Light, saying such decisions can cost a side a Premier League title; David Raya saved Enzo Le Fee's spot kick as Gunners claimed a fourth straight win Nick Wright Football Features Writer @nicholaspwright Saturday 12 September 2026 23:52, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Was Ezri Konsa's challenge on Dan Ballard enough for Sunderland to be awarded a penalty? A furious Mikel Arteta described Sunderland's penalty in Arsenal's 2-0 win at the Stadium of Light as "unacceptable". The home side were awarded a spot kick in the 54th minute when defender Ezri Konsa was adjudged to have held Sunderland's Dan Ballard by referee John Brooks. "The referee's call of penalty to Sunderland for a holding offence by Konsa on Ballard was checked and confirmed by VAR," said a statement published by the Premier League Match Centre. The statement continued by quoting the interaction between on-pitch referee Brooks and the VAR.
